Feishu's product lead now reports to Doubao's head. The move unifies ByteDance's fragmented B2B sales and positions Doubao as the company's new organizational anchor—mirroring how Douyin became the core around which domestic operations reorganized. Enterprise customers now purchase integrated AI solutions rather than separate tools, making organizational integration essential.

title: OpenAI，开源了
content: OpenAI open-sourced Codex Security CLI, a code security agent that auto-detects, verifies, and fixes vulnerabilities. It scans repositories, generates threat models, ranks vulnerabilities by real-world impact, and sandboxes tests to reduce false positives. The tool scanned 1.2 million commits in its first 30 days, finding 792 critical and 10,561 high-severity issues. However, developers report high costs and long runtimes due to default maximum reasoning settings using expensive GPT-5.6-sol. While the application layer is open, the underlying model remains proprietary.

title: 用 Rust 重写 kcptun，完全线上兼容 kcptun-go
content: kcptun-rs is a Rust rewrite of kcptun that maintains full protocol compatibility with the original Go implementation. It supports all 14 encryption algorithms and passes 68 end-to-end interoperability tests. The project achieves minimal binary size for embedded devices and optimizes performance through zero-copy KCP pipelines, batched system calls (sendmmsg/recvmmsg), and a restructured SMUX refresh loop. The author resolved cross-language discrepancies in Snappy CRC handling, Twofish key scheduling, and Blowfish implementation to ensure perfect compatibility.

title: 求助：完全离线的 iOS App 在首次弹出键盘时触发系统的联网许可弹窗
content: An iOS developer reports that a fully offline app with no network code triggers a system "allow wireless data" prompt when a TextField first gains focus and the keyboard appears. Logs show UIKit's text input initialization spawns `nw_path_evaluator_start` for dictation and network information services, which CommCenter attributes to the app as network activity. The issue occurs on iOS 27 Beta 4 with both system and third-party keyboards. The developer seeks confirmation whether this is a beta bug or intended iOS behavior where in-process UIKit/network path checks count as app networking.

title: 美国 FCC 宣布禁止进口外国产人形机器人及电力逆变器
content: The U.S. FCC banned new foreign-made humanoid robots, quadruped robots, and grid-connected power inverters from entering the U.S. market immediately. The restriction applies only to unapproved new models; authorized products are temporarily unaffected but subject to potential revocation. Exemptions for some non-Chinese suppliers are expected. The measure aims to reduce cybersecurity and supply chain risks, promote domestic manufacturing, and avoid dependence on China. Chinese company Unitree, which holds nearly one-fifth global market share in humanoid robots, may be significantly affected. Further sanctions against Chinese AI firms suspected of intellectual property theft are possible.

Users can return, buy out, or upgrade devices at lease end. Apple discontinued its previous U.S. iPhone upgrade program, migrating users to the cheaper new option. This model aims to reduce monthly costs and accelerate upgrade cycles while competing with carriers. Apple reports Q3 earnings Thursday, CEO Tim Cook's final quarterly report before becoming executive chairman.

title: Interconverting std::function with copyable_function
content: std::function and copyable_function cannot be directly interconverted. They are distinct types with different semantics—std::function requires copyability, while copyable_function relaxes some requirements. Converting between them requires explicit construction rather than implicit conversion.

title: Tame Dependabot: Group your updates, slow the cadence, keep security fast
content: Microsoft's GCToolkit Java library faced excessive Dependabot noise: 92 of 578 commits were version bumps, sometimes several daily. The fix involved three YAML configuration changes: grouping all dependencies into single monthly pull requests per ecosystem using wildcard patterns, slowing the cadence from daily to monthly, and adding Maven alongside GitHub Actions monitoring. Notably, security updates remain immediate and independent of this schedule. A default three-day cooldown on version updates now provides additional protection against compromised releases by delaying brand-new packages. This pattern reduces pull requests, CI runs, and review burden while maintaining security responsiveness.
